floater.name: wolf_tunnels
floater.title: Tunnels
floater.floater.string: This region cannot make tunnels yet (it needs the WolfSim tunnels update). Ask the region owner.
Only the region's estate owner and estate managers can make tunnels here.

button.label: Undo last point
button.name: undo_point_btn
button.tool_tip: Take the last point you clicked back (Backspace)

button.label: Start over
button.name: start_over_btn
button.tool_tip: Clear the drawing and draw a new tunnel (asks first)

button.label: Look from above
button.name: top_view_btn
button.tool_tip: Turn the camera to look straight down on the drawing, so a click lands exactly where you point

floater.text: Clear the drawing and start again?

radio_group.name: tun_kind
radio_group.tool_tip: What the tunnel is for. Path: walking, 4 m wide. Road: 6 m wide. Railway: 6 m wide and high, with a gentle slope for trains.

radio_group.name: tun_style
radio_group.tool_tip: Built: straight walls, a level floor and an arched roof. Natural: rough rock, like a cave to explore.

button.label: Add a room
button.name: room_btn
button.tool_tip: Then click on the tunnel's line: a round room (a cavern) goes there. Its size is in Expert.

button.label: Build tunnel
button.name: build_btn
button.tool_tip: Save the tunnel, make its rock, put it here and make it walkable (an old build of it is taken away first)

button.label: Walk in
button.name: walk_in_btn
button.tool_tip: Go to the floor just inside the way in

check_box.label: Expert
check_box.name: expert_check
check_box.tool_tip: Size, depth, a point's depth by hand, rooms' size, the see-through ground, the walkable parts. Most tunnels need none of it.

check_box.label: This region's tunnels
check_box.name: list_check
check_box.tool_tip: Tunnels built here before: change one, walk in or delete it

line_editor.name: tun_name
line_editor.tool_tip: The tunnel's name (also the rock object's name)

check_box.label: Stone arches at the ends
check_box.name: tun_portals
check_box.tool_tip: A stone arch round the way in and the way out

spinner.label: Width
spinner.name: tun_w
spinner.tool_tip: Width, metres (2 to 20). Path, Road and Railway set it; this changes it.

spinner.label: Rock over the roof
spinner.name: tun_cover
spinner.tool_tip: Inside the hill the floor goes deep enough to keep at least this much ground over the roof, metres (2 each time the window opens)

check_box.label: Ways in and out at ground level
check_box.name: tun_mouths
check_box.tool_tip: On: the two ends open on the ground so people can walk in. Off: the ends are as deep as the inside (for a tunnel joining another underground).

spinner.name: pt_num
spinner.tool_tip: Which point: 1 is the way in, the highest is the way out (its marker shows amber)

spinner.label: Depth (m)
spinner.name: pt_depth
spinner.tool_tip: How far that point's floor is under the ground. Changing it sets it by hand; the rest of the floor is worked out round it.

button.label: (worked out)
button.name: pt_auto
button.tool_tip: Let the tool work this point's depth out again

slider.label: Room size (m)
slider.name: room_r
slider.tool_tip: From the middle of the next room to its wall, metres (3 to 30)

check_box.label: See through the ground
check_box.name: see_through
check_box.tool_tip: While this window is open the ground is half see-through, so the tunnel inside the hill shows. It goes back to normal when the window closes.

slider.label: How much (%)
slider.name: see_through_amount
slider.tool_tip: How see-through the ground is: 25% (mostly solid) to 75% (mostly clear).

check_box.label: The region's walkable parts (for checking)
check_box.name: advanced_check
check_box.tool_tip: Every walkable box in this region, with its numbers

scroll_list.name: box_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: This region's walkable boxes. Pick one to see its numbers and change them.

button.label: Remove leftovers
button.name: leftovers_btn
button.tool_tip: Remove the walkable parts no tunnel in this region's list owns - the holes left after a tunnel's rock was deleted by hand (asks first)

button.label: Refresh
button.name: refresh_btn
button.tool_tip: Read this region's tunnels and boxes again

check_box.label: Show the boxes in the world
check_box.name: show_outlines
check_box.tool_tip: Outlines of the walkable boxes, drawn through the ground, while this window is open

button.label: Delete box
button.name: delete_btn
button.tool_tip: Remove the picked box from the region (asks first)

button.label: Go inside
button.name: go_btn
button.tool_tip: Teleport to the floor of the picked box

button.label: Save changes
button.name: save_btn
button.tool_tip: Save the picked box's new numbers to the region

scroll_list.name: tun_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: This region's tunnels. Pick one to change it, walk in or delete it.

button.label: Change
button.name: edit_btn
button.tool_tip: Draw the picked tunnel again (its route comes back), then Build again

button.label: Walk in
button.name: go_tunnel_btn
button.tool_tip: Go to the floor just inside the picked tunnel's way in

button.label: Delete
button.name: delete_tunnel_btn
button.tool_tip: Take the picked tunnel away: its rock, its walkable parts and its record (asks first)
